# Packaging System

Billy's starting video defaults, authored from the first pattern-research build ([[pattern-bank]]). These are useful first choices, not final rules. The channel has no published videos on the new positioning yet, so everything here is a starting bet. Update it as `vid-research`, `vid-framing`, and post-publish data give stronger evidence.

## Starting Packaging Defaults

*The three layers of every video, lined up to the avatar (the expert business owner using AI to make content without the slop).*

### Thumbnail style (wrapping paper)

- **Style:** Cognitive Dissonance as the lead, a contrarian line plus Billy's face or a simple prop, with bold clean type. Tool-brand logos (Claude/Anthropic burst) layered on as an enhancer, not the whole play.
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research (the direct channels, especially [[@ed-lawrence]]'s contrarian thumbnail identity).
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** CTR of contrarian thumbnails vs clean Minimal type once real videos publish.

### Format preference (box)

- **Format:** Short Process opens most often (a clear step-by-step to a specific AI-content outcome).
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research + `format-rotation-guide` avatar fit.
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** retention drop mid-process means the steps are too dense.

### Content type (gift)

- **Content type:** AI content systems and tactics, proof-backed. What the avatar keeps coming back for is "show me the system that makes content without the slop, and prove it works."
- **Evidence basis:** creator foundation (iceberg + pillars) + pattern-bank topic clusters.
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** whether the audience pulls harder on tactics (do-this-now) or systems (the whole machine).

---

## Starting Format Rotation (3+1)

*Three core formats to rotate, plus one experimental slot every 4th video.*

### Core Format 1
- **Format:** Short Process (10-20 min)
- **Why this is a good first test:** the avatar wants a clear step-by-step path, and the proven winners in Billy's lane are exactly this ("How I Use VEO 3 in 11 Minutes," Brock's Claude walkthroughs). Repeatable solo.
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research (direct channels)
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** if a specific outcome isn't named, it drifts to vague "how to improve" and stalls.

### Core Format 2
- **Format:** Listicle (10-20 min)
- **Why this is a good first test:** accessible entry for cold viewers, batchable, and proven ("15 Claude Cowork Skills I Can't Live Without," "8 AI Skills That Separate Winners From Losers").
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research (direct + adjacent)
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** going shallow. Each item needs a real payoff, not filler.

### Core Format 3
- **Format:** Case Study (10-30 min)
- **Why this is a good first test:** Billy has the proof most creators don't (the client taken from $340K to $1.3M on a 2,500-sub channel, his own 0 to 100K). Highest-trust format, and trust is the whole positioning.
- **Evidence basis:** creator proof (credibility brags) + `format-rotation-guide` (Case Study scores 5/5/5)
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** needs a real Problem-Action-Outcome arc, not just a result stated.

### Experimental Slot (every 4th video)
- **Format to test:** News (5-15 min)
- **Hypothesis:** news-jacking AI releases ("X Just Dropped / Changed Forever") pulls new viewers in a fast-moving niche. Proven convergent pattern across the research set.
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research (news-jack-release, spread 5 of 11)
- **Confidence:** experimental
- **Watch for:** promote into core only if it beats baseline across 2-3 videos AND brings the right viewer. Do not let the channel become news-dependent.

> [!note] Formats deliberately left out at first build
> Roast (no submissions or public-example pipeline yet), Deep Dive (too long for a cold channel), Interview (builds the guest more than Billy). Revisit as the channel earns trust.

## Thumbnail Strategy Test Plan

*Two primary strategies to test first, plus two active tools to layer on. Give each enough reps before judging.*

### Strategy 1
- **Strategy:** Cognitive Dissonance (contrarian)
- **Why this is a good first test:** it's Billy's voice in a thumbnail (against the grain, against the slop) and it dominates the direct channels. The highest-fit strategy in the build.
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research ([[@ed-lawrence]], [[@thisisnickys]])
- **Confidence:** medium
- **Watch for:** whether contrarian lines beat clean Minimal type on CTR.

### Strategy 2
- **Strategy:** Result / Money
- **Why this is a good first test:** money is the top driver for this audience. Anchored to numbers Billy can actually stand behind (the $340K to $1.3M client, his own 0 to 100K).
- **Evidence basis:** pattern-bank research ([[@sabrina_ramonov]], [[@nicksaraev]], [[@thisisnickys]]) + creator proof
- **Confidence:** medium (low until an AI-specific revenue number lands)
- **Watch for:** never a fabricated AI-revenue claim. A made-up number is the exact slop this brand fights.

### Active enhancers (layer on either strategy)
- **Social Hack / tool branding:** ride the Claude/Anthropic/OpenAI logos while they're hot. It's borrowed authority, used as an enhancer on top of the primary strategy, not as the strategy itself.
- **Minimal type-led:** the clean, easy-to-produce fallback (bold type + one strong visual + the tool burst), proven by [[@brockmesarich]].

- What real data showed: [decided after testing]

## Deferred to vid-thumbnail

Design guardrails (exact colors, fonts, face rules, expression rules) and the creation path (DIY vs AI workflow) are intentionally NOT set here. They need real production data Billy doesn't have yet. `vid-thumbnail` authors them once he's made actual thumbnails on the new positioning.

---

## Packaging One-Pager Checklist

*Apply to every video before posting.*

- [ ] Title under ~50 characters
- [ ] Title uses a shape from [[title-bank]] (and at least one [[power-words-bank]] word that fits)
- [ ] Thumbnail leads with one current test strategy (Cognitive Dissonance or Result/Money)
- [ ] Title and thumbnail make the SAME promise (read as one unit, not two)
- [ ] Thumbnail text 5 words or fewer
- [ ] Format matches the rotation (Short Process / Listicle / Case Study, or the News experiment)
- [ ] The promise matches what the video actually delivers (no slop, no fabricated numbers)
